comments.content: The new code uses `$this->request->getHeader('origin')` which returns an empty string if the header is missing, but the original code checked `isset($this->request->server['HTTP_ORIGIN'])`. According to PSR-7, `getHeader` returns an array of values. This should be `$this->request->getHeaderLine('origin')` to get a string, or handle the array return type properly.

The condition `if ($origin === '')` will not work correctly if `getHeader` returns an array. When the header is missing, `getHeader` returns an empty array `[]`, not an empty string. This changes the logic: previously missing origin defaulted to '*', now an empty array would not equal '' and would be used as origin value.
